title: Transitivity of tape agreement outside sets
statement: Let $d,d',d''$ be configurations with the same number of work tapes, symbol type, and input, possibly with different state types. Suppose $d$ and $d'$ agree outside position sets $F_j$, and $d'$ and $d''$ agree outside position sets $F'_j$. Then $d$ and $d''$ agree outside the unions $F_j\cup F'_j$ on each work tape $j$.
